notes: Abd b. Humayd's «قال عبد أخبرني» against the others' «حدثنا» is a difference of verb with the same chain, so it is left out
«- وهو ابن إبراهيم بن سعد -» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبي» is therefore named only by relation
«أن أبا هريرة» names the man the two got the report from (rule 5); the Prophet is the end
